title: crocodilium syriacum
intro: Crocodilium syriacum, commonly known as Syrian rue, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family, native to the Middle East and Mediterranean regions. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including anxiety, insomnia, and gastrointestinal problems, due to its health benefits such as sedative and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Syrian rue include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, promote relaxation, and alleviate symptoms of menopausal hot flashes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids like syringine, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
